notice: Explicit thresholds that turn provider values into EXPOSURE. Meeting a threshold never confirms a closure, damage or delay, and never changes an arrival date. Below a threshold the result is 'no exposure found', not 'safe'.

rules.basis: Beaufort force 10 (storm) lower bound, 89 km/h, applied to gusts
